violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: coldbar (l)- cut lettuce at 53F, cooked corn at 58F, cooked chickpeas at 56F; room temperature at register: yogurt at 59F, string cheese at 66F; cheese pizza on Speedrack at 61F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Coldbar items were refreshed; pizza on Speedrack were moved to WIF; yogurt and string cheese were discarded.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink, main handwashing sink in the Kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Maintenance replaced the handwashing soap
